decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist associated with the title 'With a Little Help from My Friends'. The source documents identify three distinct artists who have released works with this specific title: 1) **the Beatles** (D1S1), who released the original song on the album *Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band*; 2) **Joe Cocker** (D1S6, D4S1), who released a hit single version in 1968 and a debut album of the same name in 1969; and 3) **Lu Elliott** (D7S5), who released a jazz album titled *With a Little Help from My Friends* in 1968. While Ringo Starr sang the lead vocal for the Beatles' version (D1S3) and Billy Shears was the character name used (D1S5), they are performers/characters rather than the primary 'artist' entity associated with the work in the same capacity as the band or solo recording artists. The other candidates (Grease Band, Lennon, McCartney, etc.) are incidental collaborators or unrelated entities found in the text.
